This card is not tournament legal.

Ward(Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Timeout] When the Vine plays this character, each Illumineer chooses and returns one of their characters to their hand.

709870.Description:
This card is not tournament legal.

Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
709870.Flavor Text: The high-pitched whine of their tiny wings buzzes in your ear.

709874.Description:
This card is not tournament legal.

[So Last Season] Whenever this character quests, each Illumineer chooses and discards a card.
[High Cost of Fashion] During the Illumineers' turn, they may together pay 6 Ink to banish this character.

709875.Description:
This card is not tournament legal.

[Turn Back] When the Vine plays this character, banish all opposing characters with cost 3 or less.
709875.Flavor Text: A dry, whispering laugh fills the air. This is no mere vine sprout.

709896.Description:
Sing Together 6 (Any number of your or your teammates' characters with total cost 6 or more may [Exert] to sing this song for free.)

Chosen player draws a card for each different ink type of characters you have in play.

721876.Description:
[Gather the Party] You can have other Hunny characters in your deck regardless of ink type.

[Magical Summons] When you play this character, you may search your deck for a Hunny card, reveal it, and put it in your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck.

721878.Description:
Shift 3 Ink (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Violet Parr.)
Resist> +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Heroic Synergy] Whenever you play this or another Hero character, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

721882.Description:
Shift 3(You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Mr. Incredible.)
[Always United] This character gets +2 Strength for each other character you have in play.
[Let's Do This!] Whenever one of your Super characters challenges another character, draw a card.

721891.Description:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 Strength.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

722201.Description:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[Fair Trade] Once during the Illumineers' turn, an Illumineer may pay 3 lore. If they do, each Illumineer draws a card

722203.Description:
[Iron Defense] During the Vine's turn, this character gains Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
[KA-BONK!] Once during the Illumineers' turn, an Illumineer may pay 2 lore to deal 1 damage to chosen Vine character. This damage can't be reduced by Resist.

722204.Description:
Ward
[Malevolent Growth] When the Vine plays this character, make a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer and move the Vine's draw token up 1.
[Triumph] When this character is banished, the Illumineers win the scenario and open The Search for Piglet prize pack!

722207.Description:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)
[Get Back Out There] Whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, an Illumineer may pay 1 lore to ready him.

722208.Description:
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 Strength.)
[Mystical Vision] Once during the Illumineers' turn, an Illumineer may pay 2 lore. If they do, look at the top card of the Vine's deck and put it on either the top or the bottom of its deck.

722209.Description:
Ward
[Moment of Dread] When the Vine plays this character, move its draw token up 1.
[Wall of Thorns] Characters named Vine Tendril gain Bodyguard.
[Triumph] When this character is banished, the Illumineers win the scenario and open The Heart of the Vine prize pack!

722244.Description: [Accelerated Growth] When the Vine plays this character, it makes a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer.
722244.Flavor Text: Every bit as intimidating as the original.

722263.Description:
[Give Me a Sec] This character enters play exerted.
[That's Gotta Hurt] When the Vine plays this character, it deals 1 damage to each opposing character.
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one of the Vine's characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

722265.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Tough Loss] When the Vine plays this character, each Illumineer loses 2 lore.

722274.Flavor Text:
"I've never seen a plant do that before! Do you think it knows any other tricks?"
—Tigger, Hunny Barbarian

722667.Description: [The Distant Reaches] Characters get +1 Strength and gain Evasive while here. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

722668.Description: [Perfectly Protected] While the Vine has another exerted character in play, this character can't be challenged.
722668.Flavor Text: A bloom as flawless as any other the vine has created.

722669.Description: [Terrifying Surprise] When the Vine plays this character, each Illumineer chooses and banishes one of their characters.
722669.Flavor Text:
"Yikes! That vine-created copy could be Top Scarer!"
—Mike Wazowski

722670.Description: [Accelerated Growth] When the Vine plays this character, it makes a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer.
722670.Flavor Text:
"It's going to take all of us working together to pull this weed!"
—Rabbit, Hunny Paladin

722671.Description: [Thorny Locks] When the Vine plays this character, it deals 1 damage to the lowest cost character each Illumineer has in play. (If there’s a tie, the Illumineer chooses from their tied characters.)

722672.Description:
[Big Target] This character enters play exerted.
[Rash Decision] When the Vine plays this character, all opposing characters gain Reckless until the start of the Vine's next turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
[Difficult Choice] During the Illumineers' turn, they may choose and discard 2 cards total from their hands to ready this character.

722673.Description: [Big Bite] When the Vine plays this character, it deals 3 damage to the highest cost character each Illumineer has in play. (If there’s a tie, the Illumineer chooses from their tied characters.)

722674.Description: [New Growth] When the Vine plays this character, it makes a Vine Tendril.
722674.Flavor Text:
"What's that sparkly light, Mama? It's so pretty."
—Roo, Hunny Rogue

722675.Description: [Discordant Noise] The Illumineers can't play songs.
722675.Flavor Text: When they open their mouths, a horrible sound fills the air, drowning out everything else.

722676.Description:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one of the Vine's characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[Taking Root] This character enters play exerted.

722678.Description: The Vine makes a Vine Tendril for each lllumineer.
722678.Flavor Text: New tendrils make it even more difficult to find the way through the room. Perhaps a little magic will clear the path . . .

722680.Description: The Vine puts the top 2 cards of its deck into its inkwell facedown. Then, if the Vine has 7 or more cards in its inkwell, it makes a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer.
722680.Flavor Text:
"I propose, my dear archmage, that we decamp post-haste."
—Owl, Hunny Ranger

722681.Description: Banish all opposing characters and locations.
722681.Flavor Text: Colorful energy overwhelms you as mixed ink bursts from the vine.

722682.Description: The Vine draws a card for each Illumineer.
722682.Flavor Text: A skittering noise fills the air as vinelings and a thicket of thorns surround you.

722683.Description: The Illumineers together choose a character of theirs and banish them. The Vine draws a card.
722683.Flavor Text:
"What a sticky predicament."
—Winnie the Pooh, Hunny Archmage

722684.Description: The Vine banishes all opposing items and locations. If no items or locations were banished this way, the Vine draws a card.

722685.Description: The Vine plays the highest cost character from its discard for free. (If there’s a tie, the Illumineers choose from the tied characters.)
722685.Flavor Text: There's something very strange about the way they regenerate.

722686.Description: The Vine banishes all opposing damaged characters.
722686.Flavor Text:
"I knew I should have learned how to swim. Probably wouldn't help, though."
—Eeyore, Hunny Scholar

722687.Description: The Vine deals 1 damage to each opposing character. If the Vine has a character named Vine Tendril in play, it gains 1 lore.
722687.Flavor Text: Before you know it, the vine lashes out in all directions with wicked thorns!

722688.Description: Banish all characters named Vine Tendril.
722688.Flavor Text: The vine pulls back its tendrils, and you breathe a sigh of relief. Then the true scale of the plant becomes clear . . .

722689.Description: Each Illumineer chooses one of their characters and returns all their other characters to their hand. Each Illumineer loses 1 lore.

722691.Description:
[Intertwining] Characters named Vine Tendril get +1 Strength and +1 Willpower.
[Cut Back] When the Illumineers complete an encounter, banish this item.

722692.Description: [New Growth] [Exert] — The Vine makes a Vine Tendril.
722692.Flavor Text: Filled with an eerie light, the seed is already putting out roots, seeking more mixed ink.

722693.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this item.)
[Flourish] — The Vine draws a card.
[Blight] During the Illumineers' turn, they may pay 3 lore each to banish this item.

722695.Description: [Taking Root] This character enters play exerted.
722695.Flavor Text: It's just one little tendril . . . for now.
